message: I’ve learned that a power outage doesn’t have to be a hassle — it can actually be a cozy little adventure! I like to gather some candles, grab a few board games, and enjoy the quieter moments with my family. If you’re not sure what to do when the lights go out, I found a helpful resource that shares great tips for making the best of it. Remember, sometimes a little darkness leads to a lot of warmth and connection!
